summary: Three regime-based scenarios (conservative/balanced/aggressive) for one symbol. Each scenario carries a regime hypothesis, key factors weighted differently, and a corresponding trade plan. Designed for BTC/ETH-style high-liquidity symbols.
core_logic: Compute trend (EMA20/50/200), momentum (RSI), volatility (ATR%), and structural distance (last vs rolling high/low).
Conservative scenario: low leverage, only act on strong-trend regime; widest stop.
Balanced scenario: standard sizing; tolerate moderate trend; ATR-based stop.
Aggressive scenario: smaller stop / bigger target; depends on momentum extremes.
Each scenario emits a structured plan + key factor list; user chooses one.
recommended_next_step: Pick a scenario consistent with your risk profile; promote to paper-stage StrategySpec.
